views.markdown:
A rewrite of SwipeExtenderX by qwertyuiop1379 and MiRO.

Swipe gestures on every keyboard key.

* run an action by swiping up, down, left or right, or long pressing any key.
* open a menu of actions with a swipe.
* pick a glass or classic menu & show symbols in place of names.
* draw labels on the keycaps.
* insert text or the date, select, copy & paste, undo & redo, move the cursor.
* color the keyboard, keys, labels, menus & candidate bar.
* save presets & color themes.
* haptics for actions, key presses & menus.
* work alongside SwipeSelection.

* make the Swipe Threshold & Glide Type Delay sliders continuous.
* keep one decimal in a value typed into a slider.
* show slider values on iOS 26.
* give the color swatches the same rounded corners as Settings' icons.

* add Selected Menu Text Color.
* add it to the default themes.

* add Selected Accent Color & Selected Accent Text Color for the popup of a long-pressed key.
* color the other letters in that popup with Text Color.
* add both colors to the default themes.

* fix picking an accented letter from a long-pressed key, which ran the key's swipe instead.
* u/ing_jrodriguez thanks for reporting.

* name exported presets & themes after SEXReborn, so a search finds them.
* keep a save's own name when its export is imported back.

* fix presets & themes that could not be saved on a new install.
* show why a save failed in its alert.
* @MHMD thanks for reporting and testing.
* fix the settings header showing the wrong build scheme.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* name the original first in the description.
* credit SwipeExtenderX by qwertyuiop1379 and MiRO in the description.
